q: Does a Thai utility green tariff lower my market based Scope 2?
title: Thai utility green tariff and Scope 2
short: It can. Thailand has introduced utility green tariffs that attach renewable electricity to your supply. If the attributes are retired for you, cover the same year and meet the GHG Protocol Scope 2 quality criteria, the matching kWh carry a renewable factor in your market based total. Check current terms with your utility.
audience: Factories in Rayong, Chonburi and Bangkok asked by buyers for renewable electricity

ul: The kWh covered and the year.
That certificates or attributes are retired in your name.
Whether the tariff draws on new or existing plants, which some buyers ask about.

p: Stays at the Thai grid average whatever tariff you choose.
Show both totals and the tariff documents next to the bills.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills into dated, fingerprinted records and keeps location based and market based figures side by side, each with the factor and year used.
